task.description: WF-02 Step 3: write ExUnit tests for RetentionOperations/Letflow.Routers.EventRetention and the E2E pipeline spec named in AC4.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: retire oldest eligible month, display resulting retirement record
AC2: retention summary incl. protected-record count, capturable before/after
AC3: screen reachable only to PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent role

result.summary: 17 new ExUnit tests (context + router layer) all pass against real Postgres, no mocking. New E2E pipeline spec authored against the real screen/API (no msw/mocks), solving the real-eligible-month fixture problem by fabricating a genuinely backdated events partition via direct DDL (web/tests/e2e/db-exec.ts's pickEligibleBackdatedMonth/createBackdatedEventPartitionSql/seedHistoricalEventSql -- real CREATE TABLE ... PARTITION OF events DDL, real seeded event row, no server-config bypass). Found and fixed one real pre-existing regression caused by this run's own diff: test/letflow/supervisor/infrastructure_test.exs's exact-child-list assertion was stale after RetirementTaskSupervisor's addition (19->20 children).
issues: 2 pre-existing unrelated failures observed during self-check (Letflow.IdentityTest realm-resolution race, RequirementStatusInvariantsTest A9 status-index drift) -- not REQ-377 regressions, forwarded for TEST-RUNNER/RELEASE-VALIDATOR visibility
